title: Amazon SNS integration with Slack/Teams channels
description: This sample pattern demonstrates how to use Amazon SNS and AWS Lambda to deliver notifications to your Slack or teams channels.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern uses AWS CDK to setup the AWS serverless services and provides you with an example ready to be integrated with your Slack/Teams channel.
This pattern deploys one SNS topic and one Lambda function.
